program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define comps (objects-multicolor g 0))
             (foldl (lambda (obj acc)
                      (let* ((r1 (obj-r1 obj))
                             (c1 (obj-c1 obj))
                             (r2 (obj-r2 obj))
                             (c2 (obj-c2 obj))
                             (oh (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                             (ow (+ 1 (- c2 c1)))
                             (split-horizontal (> oh ow))
                             (cut (quotient (if split-horizontal oh ow) 2)))
                        (foldl (lambda (p out)
                                 (if (!= (at g (first p) (second p)) 9)
                                     out
                                     (let* ((lr (- (first p) r1))
                                            (lc (- (second p) c1))
                                            (dr (if split-horizontal
                                                    (if (< lr cut) -1 1)
                                                    0))
                                            (dc (if split-horizontal
                                                    0
                                                    (if (< lc cut) -1 1)))
                                            (nr (+ (first p) dr))
                                            (nc (+ (second p) dc)))
                                       (if (in-bounds? nr nc h w)
                                           (set-cell out nr nc 9)
                                           out))))
                               acc
                               (obj-cells obj))))
                    (empty-grid h w 0)
                    comps)))))
